notes.title: Our BIGGEST sale ever and a word on the consoles situation! 🍁
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/75c4f711e6ecc36dc054c52cf6973c39c300dc79.png[/img]

This is our BIGGEST sale ever 🍁🍂⚡️👀🥳
Help us spread the word, let your friends and family know!

[b]Instead of eating candies and watching horror movies, feel free to join Remiel at The Wail! [/b]❤️

Also, a huge thank you to all the people who took the time to leave a positive review in here. We know the game isn't perfect (we've learn [b]so much[/b] along the way) so your support really means the world to us. We're so glad to see some of you resonate with our strange universe, even with its flaws ♥

We can't wait to talk more about our next project, and show how much we've grown and learn. Stay tuned dear Wanderers, we'll have news soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/c1819a4a52c91b783c19760ddf04f915b9d260e9.png[/img]

[b]So, about the consoles![/b]

The game is out on PS4, PS5 and Switch. We're aware those versions have bugs, and our partner Forthright who did the port is currently working on patches to fix them.

They're also working on the XBox version, but we don't have a release date to communicate yet.
Like us, they're also a very small team, so things take time. Thanks a lot for your patience ♥

[b]So anyway, if you feel like helping us a bit more, spread the word about the sale and/or leave us a positive review on Steam[/b]. It helps more than you can imagine, both on a marketing side and on a mental health side 🙃 (we actually made a [url=https://twitter.com/RedlockStudio/status/1582400915822477312]Twitter thread about indie devs and mental health[/url], if you'd like to read more about that topic)

Take care of yourselves and enjoy this beautiful spooky season 🍂🧡

notes.title: Shattered is 1 year old! News on the consoles release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/f284311bafb84b9e3d8d2ecd4089f9067e84c498.png[/img]

[h3]Since today is Shattered's anniversary, here's a little overview of what we did since last February![/h3]

• Well, first we kept bettering the game for around 6 months. We made several content & bugfix updates, until we reached the best doable version of the game we wanted to achieve by the end of June.

• Then, we took a little break (yay summer!), before getting back to work. We took the time needed to find a trusted partner for, finally, a consoles port! Read more on that just below ♥

• And we may have started to actually work on a new project... We obviously can't tell anything for now, but be sure you'll be hearing about us soon enough 🤫

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/5c3292c7cda7cd001be7390dd2714efaa563fae0.png[/img]

[i]"Publisher Forthright Entertainment and Redlock Studios will explore, slash, and hack their way onto Switch, Playstation, Xbox, and Epic Game Store in Q1 2022 with Shattered - Tale of the Forgotten King.  The Epic MegaGrant recipient game has an intriguing story that unfolds a universe with deep lore combined with one of the most unique and breathtaking aesthetics from any game that was released last year."[/i]

...This is what you can read on our dear partner's website, [url=https://www.forthrightentertainment.com/fe/forthright-is-excited-bring-shattered-to-consoles/]Forthright Entertainment[/url].

[h2]We're super glad to announce that thanks to this partnership, Shattered will finally come out on Playstation, Xbox and even Switch!!
Tune in March 22nd for the date announcement ♥[/h2]


Thanks for your everlasting support, Wanderers ♥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/a30787e2c8d683b79b7b7d5d95d2c3d3d1d3db80.png[/img]

notes.title: WE'RE BACK! With a patch notes & a discount: 35% off for 10 days ♥
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello there dear Wanderers! We're so happy to get back to you![/h1]

We hope you had a wonderful summer, with lots of games and sweet wandering ♥
We have something for you to kick off this back to work time with the right foot: [b]a discount![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/fb79e77edef723babf8d05e0a30c8e8dc0bb0b59.png[/img]

Here is what we've done:

• Game is lighter! It's now 6.5GB!
• The performance issues in the snowy lands has been fixed
• Some UI textures sometimes went all blur, not anymore!
• Dashing foes can no longer keep the player aggro after you died
• The graphical options menu now always shows the right resolution ;)

[b][i]So, if you haven't tried Shattered already, this is kind of the best time ever! The game is in its final version along with a big discount, soooo we can't wait to have your feedback![/i][/b]


[b]And so, now that we're here, what is next for Redlock Studio?[/b]

Well... We can't tell you exactly what's going on, really.
But we're onto stuff.
[i]Cool stuff.[/i]

We're sorry we have to keep the mysterious act for now, but we can't wait to tell you more (soon!) ♥

In the meantime, don't hesitate to join our Discord if you want to ask anything or chat directly with some of us.

notes.title: SHATTERED APOCRYPHA
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/b0c300ac6b998c1229edf08b68fb1220ee572190.png[/img]

[h2]Hello everyone! We’re so happy to see you again.[/h2]
[b]This is possibly the last content patch notes we’ll ever make, so we particularly wanted to thank you again for all the support, presence and feedback you blessed us with.[/b]

[h3]This patch notes is happening entirely thanks to you ♥
And to celebrate, we decided to go for a big 35% off for the week! 🥳[/h3]

We’ve been working on this update since last February, thanks to all the feedback we’ve got, mostly regarding the lack of diversity with the ennemies. We made new patterns, new FX and basically new foes to inhabit Hypnos, so we hope you’ll like them :D
[i](A little hotfix is already planned for tonight, but you shouldn't even see the difference! Just to let you know it's be normal if you see a new little something to download in an hour or so.)[/i]


[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]

[b]• Basic ennemies now have special capacities!
• Spellcasters!
• Healers!
• More lore unlocked after defeating the Watchers
• More lore unlocked after defeating the Demiurges
• New post process for the visual render
• An additionnal bastion
• A new camp in the Ancient Lands
• More environmental narrative ♥
[/b]

[b]CHANGES:[/b]

[b]• A whole new tutorial! 
• Total rework of the Transcendance ending[/b]
• The angle for backstabbing is more permissive
• Limbo Wells are more visible, you can’t miss them no more !
• Foes can now hear you approaching, you have to walk slowly to surprise them

[b]BUGFIX:[/b]

• Andras’ kick can no longer cause the game to be slowed down at respawn
• Jugulus’ spells no longer keep on going after the Wanderer’s death
• Oph stopped shrinking some of the weapons (admit it, it was fun though)
• The hitboxes of the blades traps in Jugulus’ castle have been reduced
• We added a little cooldown on the perfect parry so it can’t be spammed
• The Cross spell sometimes didn’t apply its damage
• The grenades you sent back to their launcher can no longer hurt you
• The Sword of Remembrance couldn’t be unlocked in German
• Hitboxes of the brambles have been fixed
• Various fixes of the video options menu
• AI are less passive, be careful !
• The hitboxes of the Legionaries’ strikes have been refined
• Few fixes of level art

[b]As always, don't hesitate to let us know what you think of it all :D[/b]

[h3]Want to chat with us?[/h3]
• [b][url=https://discord.gg/ZsnU3bM]Join our wonderful Discord ♥ [/url][/b]
• [url=https://twitter.com/RedlockStudio]Twitter[/url]
• [url=https://www.instagram.com/redlockstudio/]Instagram[/url]
• [url=https://www.facebook.com/taleoftheforgottenking]Facebook[/url]
• [url=https://shatteredking-thegame.fr/]Website[/url]

Thanks a lot, and, well...

notes.title: The new languages are in!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/0185aae6dbf0e1a5d8c8b83a1d3f2bfd6646b88e.png[/img]

[b]YES, YOU READ RIGHT![/b]
We're so eager to let you know that Shattered is now available in 4 new languages. We're so excited, and cannot wait to get your feedback!!

It is definitely not the only thing we've done on the game this past month, so...
[h2]Here you go for the patch notes![/h2]

[h3]FIXES: [/h3]

[list]
[*] The sword collision system is way more precise (no more hits not landing when they should!)
[*] The Wanderer's hits now land or miss the foes' shields more consistantly depending on your position
[*] The keybinding menu now displays the keys depending on your layout
[*] Multiple sound design fixes
[*] The triangle teleporters are more dynamic, and won't kill you anymore nor let your ennemies hit you while you're in there :D
[*] Loot in the maze will no longer disappear when recharging a game
[*] Higher resolutions are now supported (yay for the 4K!)
[*] No more random heart attacks when riding your hoverboard in the Ancient Lands
[/list]

[h3]ADDITIONS: [/h3]

[list]
[*] Russian, Spanish, Simplified Chinese and German are supported!
[*] Aaaand please welcome the Steam cloud save!
[/list]

[h3]CHANGES: [/h3]

[list]
[*] Slopes are now taken into account in combat: no more hitting the ground or slicing the air above your ennemies' heads when fighting on a hill!
[*] When using the Catalyst or a potion, you won't be able to dash nor attack, but the animation time has been reduced 
[*] The parry frames are now in the beginning of the animation, for it to be more easily executed
[*] More feedback when taking damage and landing hits
[*] Kûta now opens her menu from her very first dialog, and Y'aak also gives the Whisperer Mark right away
[*] The boost of the Espada is now on the same input as the sprint: press once to activate, and a second time to stop it
[*] Jumping keeps the sprint momentum
[*] Malkel's AI has been changed a little bit
[*] Groups of foes guarding chests in the Ancient Lands are now in small bastions
[/list]


[h3]Change of price[/h3]

As you may have noticed, during the Early Access we said the game's price would slightly increase at its full release, like most games getting out of EA do. For various reasons, we finally decided not to do it right away, and the price stayed the same.

We're now 3 months post release, we haven't stopped working on Shattered to better it as much as we can, and as it's now available in 6 languages in total, we decided the price change could fit with this update.

[h3]You're enjoying Shattered?[/h3]
If yes, please consider leaving us a positive review ♥
As a small indie team, we rely a lot on those so it is a tremendous help for us. We read all the reviews we get and try to take them into account as much as possible (as you can see in any of our updates really). Thank you!

[h3]What's coming next?[/h3]
We're still working on a last major patch notes to come by the beginning of summer.
It will be about fight & foes, and will contain a lot of big changes, reworks and optimizations.

Thanks for your attention and, well...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/5804cb443e535700ff89a5772760dc8c4af6d64e.png[/img]

[b][u]Bugfix[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Menu inputs have been smoothed out
[*] We reworked the input system to support all types of keyboards
[i](Caution! You'll perhaps have to rebind your inputs)[/i]
[*] Fixed the rebinding bugs
[*] Multiple crashes have been fixed

[list]

notes.title: And so, what's next?
notes.notes:
Dear Wanderers,

What a week it has been!
Thank you so much for your support and feedback. Our Discord welcomed lots of newcomers and we're so grateful for that. If you have any question about the game or want to chat with us, [url=https://discord.gg/8aDMYnN]don't hesitate to join too :)[/url]


Despite a lot of support for which we can't say thank you enough, we've also received a handful of negative reviews since the launch. We do read every single one of them and try to take them into account (when it's not just a matter of taste). No matter what was the outcome of your review, thanks for taking the time to write feedback!

[b][u]So, what's next?[/u][/b]

[b]First, a patch notes![/b]
We're already working on a [i][b]post launch patch notes, to come next week.[/b][/i]
Here is what we're focusing on: 

[i]• Fix of some crashes 
• UI bugfix and UX improvement
• Improvement of global navigation & level art for your in game orientation
• Balancing of the Demiurges
• Corrections of localization / descriptions of some items[/i]

[b]Second, Steam Achievements![/b]
They should be ready for next week as well.
Most of them will be unlocked retroactively, and the few ones we can't make completely retroactive will be specified in the patch notes. We hope you'll like them :D

[b]Third, new languages![/b]
Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Russian and German are on the making, and should be available next month!
We do know Turkish players are very interested in playing Shattered. We're trying to make it happen soon :)

That's for the short term objectives.
Don't hesitate to let us know if you have any question!
Also, if you already played and liked the game, please consider leaving a positive review. It's a tremendous help for us in terms of visibility, and we're definitely not done bettering Shattered ♥

notes.title: Last patch notes until full release
notes.notes:
[b]Hello there, dear Wanderers![/b]

As you know, we’re now less than a month away from Shattered’s full release. But we didn’t want to let you hanging until then with a 3 months old version of the game, so… This update is a big one.
Such a big one, that we won’t tell you precisely what we fixed and added, because there is SO much. We’ll just let you discover the reworked areas, new NPCs, etc. etc... ♥

What we’re going to do though, is telling you what is still missing and the bugs we already know and are still working on.
Let’s have a look:

• You now have access to everything in the game, EXCEPT for the last zone. That means the full release will still have surprises for you : the said last zone, endings, last Boss… 
• The Quick Access Inventory will be improved & fixed
• We’ll add and/or balance certain craft recipes
• There’s a bit of polishing left on combat gameplay and a few enemies/Bosses
• We’ll do some level art polishing (collision issues etc), and some UI/FX/visual rendering improvement.
• For more fun, we let a few occasional crashes the possibility to happen. (No, we’re sorry about that and are investigating the matter as you’re reading this)

Due to the amount of changes we made, you really have to start a new game, otherwise your save will probably end up completely corrupted.

This will also be the last update until the full release.

We hope you’ll enjoy, and as always, don’t hesitate to let us know what you think, here or on social media ♥

notes.title: Build 0.12 Hotfix!
notes.notes:
Hey again dear Wanderers,

[b]Thank you so much for your quick feedback and positive comments on the last update, we're so glad you liked it ♥[/b]
We've been able to make a little hotfix, since a few problematic bugs had shown up.

Here it is:

    • Fix of the crashes that happened when fighting the Stranger and Gheb
    • Fix of display bugs in the binding menu
    • Fix of the freeze that happened when you used a Mark from the inventory
    • The casting bar of the Marks no longer stays on the screen afterwards
    • Loot still appears even if you hide the HUD
    • Fix of the link between Limbo and the door of Khotar
    • Legionaries now have a thrust attack with a wider dash, and gained a few adjustments on their AI
    • Damage reduction for the charged attacks, light and heavy 
    • The door of Khotar can't be skipped anymore
    • We also made a few display corrections on certain maps.


As always, we're all ears for your feedback!
If you'd like to report something, ask a question or chat with us, don't hesitate to join our official Discord server ♥ https://discord.gg/cGmC9Bt

notes.title: Build 0.12: a new Demiurge and a new zone!
notes.notes:
Dear, dear Wanderers

We took longer than usual to craft today’s update.

We decided it was worth it to make you wait a while, since we had so many things to work on and finally show you. We made so many corrections, changes and additions, we really really hope you'll like everything that's new ♥

[b]In order to make sure it all works fine, please remember to start a new game after downloading the patch notes.[/b]

So, what have we done? :D

[b]BUGFIX:[/b]
• Stamina comes back up at a normal pace when the shield is destroyed.
• Legionaries’ spears can no longer hurt you after you killed their bearer.
• Items no longer have a negative value in the inventory, and the whole system is more stable.
• Items are correctly synchronized betwen the quick access and the inventory.
• Menus are finally fine when navigated with a mouse.
• Stats bars of the weapons are fixed in the inventory and no longer comes on top of the artefacts.
• Hierarchs no longer scream after they died.
• Spatialization of the Lost Souls’ sounds re-established.
• Homonculus’ damage fixed no matter the pattern.

[b]OPTIMIZATIONS:[/b]

    • Lots of maps optimizations 
    • Lots of assets optimizations
    • No more FPS drops when picking up items, or when the inventory contains a lot of them.

[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]
• NEW BOSS AND DEMIURGE: THE PENITENT KING
• NEW AREA: IMBOLT FOREST
• Total rework of the Limbo Gates, they’re now all connected to a single one on the Heart of Limbo. We removed the keys associated to the old doors.
• The Crucible is now working : items creation and weapon improvement.
• Additions of all the resources needed for creating items and improving weapons.
• New visual effect on the perfect parry during the activation window.
• New variations of animations on the different weapons.
• You can now scroll down in the long texts with the right stick of your controller.
• Visual options (gamma and display modes).
• You can finally remap your keyboard as you want ! (Controllers as well)
• Access to the « options » menu from the main menu
• You can now improve the Catalyser’s efficiency as well as its number of uses.
• Foes now drop items when they die.
• New screen when you pick up an important item.
• New notification when you pick up an item.
• Interfaces now detect if you’re using a keyboard of a controller.
• New visual and sound effects when using a healing/recovering item.

[b]CHANGES: [/b]

    • The Pretorian has been entirely reworked.
    • Visual rework of Myosis and Niphur. Added teleport platform in the bastion of the Edge of Imbolt.
    • Changes on the heavy charged attack : it now allows to jump towards the locked foe (damage is 30 % on the first phase, 70 % for the second one).
    • Reorganization and visual rework of Limbo.
    • Changes on the visual effects of the Wanderer’s attacks.
    • Changes of rythm of the Wanderer’s attacks. 
    • Visual rework of all the items icons.
    • It’s now impossible to equip non consumable items.
    • All menus now pause the game.
    • You can now use several potions in a row that will be consumed one after the other.
    • Buff of damage on the heavy attack.
    • Foes and Bosses give more Limbo Essence when they die.
    • Added patrols of legionaries depending on the zones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34950399/7376cb2075f38a91a08e45dfd9d7296794e0479e.jpg[/img]

Until next time, Wanderers ♥

notes.title: WINTER SALES! Build 0.09 UP AND RUNNING!
notes.notes:
Aaaand here is the 9th patch notes everyone! To celebrate, [b]we're doing our very first discount for these Winter Sales [/b]:D That's your chance to add Shattered to your library (or a friend's) ♥

We're super proud of this big one and can't wait to read what you think of it.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34950399/86fa6b89b512b27ac04c82a936141ce84c5a00bd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Build 0.08 online!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear Wanderers!
How was your October? We hope Samhain was fairly celebrated ;)

Ours was pretty busy: we were at the Paris Game Connection, right next to the Paris Games Week. For those of you who don't know, it is the professionnal part of the event, where you can meet lots of others devs, publishers, editors etc. (we were particularly looking for help to launch the finished game as best as possible, translate it in as much languages as possible, and hopefully port it on consoles a little bit quicker). We'll see how it goes!

Oh, and there's a few new things in Hypnos...


[b]PATCH NOTES #8![/b]

[b]BUGFIX[/b]: 
    • Radiant Essences no longer use a Superior one.
    • The precedent level correctly unload after the Whisperer's Mark is used (no more mashup between the levels!).
    • No more getting stuck in the game options.
    • The player’s Quick Access is now correctly saved when loading a game!
    • Fixed a bug causing the player to appear falling in the middle of nothing after using the Whisperer's Mark.
    • No more unobtainable keys! You shall now open gates.
    • The dialog widget now correctly udpates its color theme when the Whisperer is talking. 
      

[b]OPTIMISATIONS[/b]:
    • Magic bolts won't cause FPS drops anymore.
    • The hard freeze upon using the Whisperer's Mark from the inventory is now fixed.

[b]ADDITIONS[/b]: 
    • Fade out animation for enemies' lifebars upon death.
    • Clearer feedback on how many essences you get when killing a mob.
    • New ennemies: the “rocketter” and the “grenade thrower” :D
    • A new death screen!
    • Bunch of new NPCs! Their quests are not implemented yet, but you can get to know them a little bit while we add their complete narrative... (Let us know what you think about them :) )
    • Oh, and you can also trade with them!
    • Little level design modifications & visual changes in environments. We'll let you discover what and where ;)
    • New area: the Wall of Devesh, beyond North of Myosis
    • A new item that you'll particularly appreciate in the darkest places: a little sentient light that you can summon to illumate your way!


[b]Changes[/b]: 
    • If you kill a locked ennemy, the camera will now switch the lock target to the next foe, instead of exiting the lock mode.
    • New Fx for Homonculus' explosions.
    • New Sound Design for the Legionnaires.
    • New Fx for the gunner ennemies.
    • A few Sound Design upgrades for some of the Wanderer's moves.
    • Sound lifting for some Elite enemies ; changed on-hit sound for it to not be confused with the player’s one anymore. 


This one was a big one for us.
We really hope you like all the changes!

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:

[b]BUGFIX:[/b]
[list]

[*] Stamina doesn't recharge during the heavy attacks animations anymore.

[*] Click anywhere else to exit the Quick Access selection in the main UI.

[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.07 is up!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
September was such a busy month for us and we're glad to show you the content of the 7th patch notes :D

UI:
- We noticed some technical issues, thanks to your feedback on the inventory and therefore, instead of correcting piece by piece every bit of code on this interface way too old and unstable, we created a brand new architecture, much more stable and easier to fix in the future. Nothing changes in terms of visual, but the whole code behind it has been reworked to avoid all the mistakes made 3 years ago when we created the first prototype. This is still a new UI, so some bugs could still show up, but it will now be way faster for us to fix them, without taking the risk to break something else.

FOES & FIGHT:
- Legionaries have slightly different combos and get stronger depending on which area they're located. We tried to bring variety in their actions without changing them entirely, so they “evolve” and are properly aligned with the increasing difficulty curve. 
- The strongest legionaries also have new attacks (we'll let you find out what it's about!)
- We also fixed a bug where legionaries gave twice their essence (sorry :P )
- The Lost Souls now drop 15 essences instead of 30.
- Damage of the roll attack reduced by 30%

Other minor bug fix:
The Early Access intro text and the language/keyboard layout selection will stop appearing after the first time.

notes.title: Build 0.06 now running!
notes.notes:
Long time no see, dear Wanderers! We hope you're all doing well. Contrarily to what our month-long silence may have let you think, we didn't stop working on Shattered, we just decided to go a little bit easier and reduce our neverending work days for this crazy hot august month.
Here is the result of our summery work :D

ADDITIONS:

- The Chorozon mark, which teleports you back to the Limbo
- The Whisperer mark, which teleports you to the last activated Limbo Well
(this one is located at the heart of Limbo, where the Whisperer is.)
- A sprint attack: if you press the attack input while sprinting, the Wanderer will slide on the ground for a few meters then slash with his sword.
- A new Catalyser! We are trying a more conventionnal approach with healing: an item that contains healing charges that you refill at a Limbo Well. Right now there is only one charge, and you cannot upgrade it yet, so we left the old one aswell.

MODIFICATIONS:

- We changed the AI for most of the basic ennemies. They will now try to not overlap each other with their attacks. Hopefully fighting 1v5 should be fairer now.
- But beware, they also learned how to do longer combos.
- We are also starting to implement different levels of Legionnaires (the main foes): some will be tougher with slightly different animations and patterns.
- We also changed the Wanderer's attacks: they are faster, cost less stamina but do less damages.
- Gheb invocations have less health.
- The elite monsters' and bosses' strikes take longer to launch.
- We are trying something on the jump: only the double jump will now cost stamina, not the regular one.


BUGFIX:

- A lot of collision bugs with the basic ennemies are fixed. Hitting ennemies should feel more responsive and rewarding now.
- Sword collisions are now way more consistant and accurate.
- Level Up menu fixed! You won't lose your essences when exiting the menu anymore.

We are aware of bugs around the inventory and menus (sometimes you have to double click to open a sub-menu), we are working to fix that as soon as possible.
We deactivated the E key in the menu (the confirmation key) for now because of a lot of bugs associated to it, we will fix it soon and bring it back.

WHAT'S NEXT?

- LORE ! 
- Glyph system
- A loot system
- New zones
- Aaaaand bugfixes

notes.title: Build 0.05 is up! Want to join our Discord server?
notes.notes:
Hello dear Wanderers :)
We hope the heat is not too crushing where you live, because it definitely is here and we're regularly making water fights pauses to survive.
Anyways, here is what we've been working on this week!

ADDITIONS:
- It's now possible to start a combo with the dash attack
- New feedbacks when hitting foes
- The jump now costs a small amount of stamina
- No more attack cancelling when hitting a wall, the Wanderer is pushed back instead
- The animation of the first light attack has been modified to be more dynamic (let us know what you think about it!)
- The animation and timing of the perfect parry have been changed to be more difficult to realize.

WHAT'S NEXT: 

- Add items allowing to go back to the last Limbo Well (almost done, we just need to test it a bit)
- Rework the basic foes to make them more interesting to fight and more rewarding to defeat (different IA, group IA, loot system...)
- Add a "sprinted" attack
- More bug fix and optimisation!

OUR DISCORD SERVER:
Want to report bugs or chat with us more directly?
Here you go! https://discord.gg/WZyBzt3
We also have a Role Play section (Madam Lockhart Counter) if you'd like to challenge your writing and discover a bit more of Redlock Studio's extended narrative universe.

Don't forget to drink water & see you soon, Wanderers ♥

notes.title: Build 0.04 is coming
notes.notes:
Wanderers, the war against infinite load screens has been declared! With this update, you shouldn't be getting anything like this anymore.
We hope.
We sacrificed all our coffee stock to the mystic gods of UE4, so it should work.

BUG FIX:

- Fix of The Stranger who did spawn but didn't move (and became an automatic turret)

WHAT'S NEXT?
Well, pretty much the same things that we talked about in the last patch notes. Thank you for your attention & support, Wanderers ♥

notes.title: Build 0.03 is live! What are we planning next?
notes.notes:
Hi there :D
We keep working on Shattered, fixing bugs and optimizing everything we can, thanks to your feedback. We're super thankful to everyone of you playing the game again and again, patch after patch, letting us know what's better and what's not. That's amazing.

ADDITIONS:
- Sound settings menu
- Video settings menu

BUG FIX:
- HUD is now really responsive to different screen resolutions
- Limbo gates are fixed

CHANGES: 
- Backstab has been nerfed

WHAT'S NEXT?
- Inverted Y axis
- Items allowing to teleport back to Limbo wells & Limbo heart


You may also have seen a little update last weekend: it was just a sneaky hotfix to fix static foes. Seemed like they didn't want to attack you anymore. Noble, but not so fun!
As for what's coming later: when we're done fixing bugs and polishing the game as much as possible, the future updates will mostly be about the fighting system. We've been writing down all your feedback and suggestions, and we have a lot of ideas on how we're going to drastically improve the game feel. It will take a bit of time, though.
Thank you again so much for your enthusiasm & patience, Wanderers!

notes.title: Shattered's Early Access is available!
notes.notes:
Wanderers,

[b]Now is the time! HYPNOS IS OPEN![/b]
We can't express how excited we are. This Early Access may be just a part of the journey we want you to take in our universe, but it is the first step. The huge, thrilling and kind of surreal first step.

This Early Access version of Shattered – Tale of the Forgotten King that you're about to play is still in development. It is likely (if not certain) that it contains several bugs. Some of them will be fun, and some of them... less fun.
You could disappear in a hole and fall forever into the void, fight invicible ennemies -or become invicible yourself?- lose some preciously collected resources, experience strangely positive situations or terribly unfair ones!
Don't be scared, we're working everyday to fix those pitfalls, to better the content and balance the game in its entirety. We'll take your feedback and suggestions into account in order to make Shattered the best game possible.
The end of the game will be integrated during the early access phase, after some crucial updates, not to spoil the resolution of the main narrative arc.

Thank you for your presence and your support.

Welcome to Hypnos.

notes.title: Welcome in our universe, dear Wanderers
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We really wanted to thank you for your welcoming here.

We're a 10 people independent studio based in the beautiful city of Lyon, France. Our creative director, game designer and narrative designer have known each other for over ten years: they spent most of  their youth playing table top RPG together. From those game sessions rose entire original universes that we decided to turn into videogames. Shattered - Tale of the Forgotten Kingis the first stone in the world of Redlock, and we'd like to see it as an entrance door. Ready to cross the threshold, Wanderers?

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34950399/2c873c056e75aa6e855b2fb161df956e15147c7c.jpg[/img]

You may have already heard about Shattered since we kickstarted it in November 2016 and had it funded at 138%.
From there, we got other public fundings added to our budget that allowed us to go further in the development. We're now almost done with our first game Shattered - Tale of the Forgotten King, but it still need some polishing, so we decided to go for an Early Access. The goal is to get as much feedback from our community as possible, and let the game be known before its official release.

So thank you for your presence dear Wanderers, we can't wait to show you more ♥
